questions.stem: The new subsidy is intended to ______ the impact of rising costs on low-income families.

explanation.conclusion: mitigate the impact 是固定搭配，意为“减轻影响”。

1.note: militate 常与 against 连用，意为“妨碍、不利于”，后面不能直接跟 the impact 作宾语。

hints: 空格后直接跟宾语，需要一个及物动词。
哪个词常与 impact、risk、effects 搭配？

questions.stem: 以“终身学习的重要性”为题写一篇 150 至 200 词的议论文。

scoring_points.point: 两到三个分论点并展开

questions.sample_answer: Lifelong learning is very important in modern society. First, technology changes fast. Second, it makes people happy. So we should keep learning.
questions.label: 写作

cards.back: mitigate　v. 减轻，缓和。常见搭配：mitigate the impact / risk / effects。易混：militate against（不利于）。
